security_audit.summary: All 31 static alerts are false positives caused by documentation, metadata URLs, Markdown formatting, installation paths, and normal Chinese text. One high-severity issue remains: package.json declares an automatic postinstall hook, but the referenced script is absent from the audited files.

remediation.issue: The npm postinstall hook executes scripts/install.js, which is missing from the audited file set.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the lifecycle hook or include scripts/install.js in the submitted source so reviewers can verify its behavior before publication.

content.value_statement: Project facts often fail to secure attention, trust, or action from decision-makers. Pitchcraft organizes those facts into audience-focused briefings with evidence and a clear ask.
actual_capabilities: Structures briefings with Hook, Context, Proposal, Evidence, and Ask sections.
Supports project kickoffs, status updates, wrap-ups, investor pitches, and solution selling.
Asks for missing audience details, source materials, risks, metrics, and decisions.
Adapts section emphasis to the selected scenario and audience concerns.
Checks metric sources, risk responses, scope, dependencies, and requested actions.
limitations: It depends on accurate facts, metrics, and audience context supplied by the user.
It does not independently verify market data, financial claims, or business outcomes.
It produces briefing content, not finished presentation design or visual assets.
It does not replace legal, financial, or investment advice.

use_cases.title: Secure Project Approval
use_cases.description: Build a kickoff briefing that connects business urgency, existing assets, scope, evidence, risks, and required resources.

use_cases.title: Report Progress Clearly
use_cases.description: Turn milestones, metrics, risks, and dependencies into a concise update with recommendations and explicit decisions.

use_cases.title: Present a Business Case
use_cases.description: Frame market need, product value, traction, differentiation, and the next commitment for investors or customers.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Status Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a status update for [project]. Ask me for completed work, key metrics, risks, next steps, and decisions needed.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Project Kickoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a kickoff briefing for [audience]. Organize the opportunity, current assets, scope, milestones, differentiation, risks, and resource request.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an Investor Pitch
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an investor pitch for [company]. First identify missing market, product, traction, team, competition, funding, and milestone details.

prompt_templates.title: Transform a Briefing for a New Audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this [source briefing] for [new audience and scenario]. Preserve verified metrics, expose assumptions, adjust emphasis, and end with one specific ask.

output_examples.input: Prepare a status update for executives about a delayed integration and improved conversion.
output_examples.output: Conversion increased 20 percent in the same account pool, but integration is two weeks late. Add one engineer to protect the launch date.

output_examples.input: Create a kickoff brief for a customer analytics project.
output: Hook: Teams cannot identify churn risks before renewal discussions.
Context: Existing product events and account data provide a practical starting point.
Proposal: Deliver risk scoring and account alerts in two milestones.
Evidence: The team already operates the required data pipeline.
Ask: Approve two engineers and analytics support for eight weeks.

output_examples.input: Turn product facts into an investor pitch outline.
output: Market opportunity and urgent customer problem
Funding amount, use, and target milestones

best_practices: Provide the audience role, existing knowledge, concerns, and desired decision before drafting.
Define every metric with its source, comparison period, and population.
Pair each material risk with its root cause, mitigation, owner, and current status.
anti_patterns: Do not submit activity lists without explaining business impact or audience relevance.
Do not invent evidence, metrics, market data, customer cases, or financial projections.
Do not present vague problems without options, a recommendation, and a specific request.

faq.question: What briefing types does Pitchcraft support?
faq.answer: It supports project kickoffs, status updates, wrap-ups, annual reviews, investor pitches, and solution selling.

faq.question: Does Pitchcraft write the briefing without source material?
faq.answer: It can draft from available context, but it should identify missing facts and request important materials first.

faq.question: Can it adapt content for different audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. Audience role, familiarity, priorities, cost concerns, and time constraints can change the structure and emphasis.

faq.question: Does it verify metrics and business claims?
faq.answer: No. Users must provide reliable sources and definitions for metrics, forecasts, market data, and customer evidence.

faq.question: Can it create presentation slides?
faq.answer: It creates structured briefing content and outlines. It does not produce finished slide design or visual assets.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through skill installation or prompt-based use.
